title: NotifyOutput
description: `emitted` is the honest verdict. When false, `reason` names why — the node this replaces reported success with `sent:false` underneath, so a run whose only outbound action failed completed green.

emitted.description: True only when a notification row was actually created.

reason.description: Machine-readable refusal reason when `emitted` is false: title_required | audience_required | unknown_audience | role_required | no_acting_user_on_this_run | emitter_error.
